verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a SaaS compliance platform, so contracted processing region and cross-border data handling are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence pack does not document data residency, processing regions, or cross-border transfer terms. The 'jurisdiction' mention (hummingbird-docs-5) refers to validating regulatory filings, not to where data is processed, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can verify the contracted processing region and cross-border handling for the chosen deployment
